complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting each query range individually takes O(q * n log n) which exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix frequency tables precompute counts in O(n * C) memory to resolve queries in O(C) operations each.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate notices the small upper bound on numbers (<= 100) and uses prefix frequency counting.

hints.title: Small Value Range Observation
hints.text: The input values range strictly between 1 and 100, which enables frequency table tracking across the array.

hints.title: Cumulative Value Counts
hints.text: Construct prefix frequency counts for each value up to 100 to determine element presence in any range in constant time.

hints.title: Consecutive Value Comparison
hints.text: For each query, iterate through all present values in ascending order and track the smallest difference between adjacent pairs.
